leads.title: ‘Critical’ flood warning alert in Charleston extended to 1 a.m. Several downtown streets closed.
leads.summary: National Weather Service has issued a ‘critical’ alert for flooding in the Charleston, SC, area through 11 p.m. on Oct. 4. Do not travel unless you are fleeing flood waters or under an evacuation order, NWS says.

leads.title: City purchases home of disgraced judge to help fix flooding issues in West Ashley neighborhood
leads.summary: The city of Charleston has a plan to improve flooding issues in West Ashley. It involves the home that belonged to former magistrate judge James B. Gosnell, Jr., who is currently awaiting sentencing.
